verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that answers from your notes, plans multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve. It also offers in-app AI chats with notes as context, property auto-fill and one-click image analysis, and the pricing page lists the AI assistant as a feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the delegation workflow, and deeper documentation of multi-step task execution (it is described in a single line, and each change requires approval rather than running autonomously).
